name: Maigo no Kimochi
source:
Naoto lives in a famous club that his mother owns, that's why Naoto is well known around the town. One day he sees his classmate Asami wondering around downtown and falling victim to nanpa. After listening to her circumstances Naoto hides Asami in his house.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
直人住在母親經營的知名俱樂部裡，因此在鎮上頗有名氣。一天，他看見同班同學麻美在市中心遊蕩時被人搭訕。聽過她的遭遇後，直人把麻美藏進自己家中。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/09/vn-of-month-january-1998.html]vndbreview[/url]]
